3.en: The new phone has immense storage space.
3.zh: 这款新手机有极大的存储空间。

8.en: The camera is highly sensitive to light.
8.zh: 这台相机对光线非常敏感。

12.en: Please give me a precise time, not an approximate one.
12.zh: 请给我一个确切时间，不要用大概的时间。

15.en: Avoid using your phone in extreme heat.
15.zh: 避免在极热的环境下使用手机。

20.en: There is a possibility of rain this afternoon.

23.en: The idea sounds abstract until you see an example.
23.zh: 在看到例子之前，这个想法听起来很抽象。

26.en: We reduced the file size before sending it.
26.zh: 发送前我们缩小了文件大小。

31.en: Turn off notifications so they do not distract you.
31.zh: 关掉通知，免得它们让你分心。

36.en: The bright screen created an illusion of daylight.
36.zh: 明亮的屏幕营造出白昼的错觉。

40.en: I barely slept last night because of the noise.
40.zh: 昨晚噪声太大，我几乎没睡。

47.en: We use this app on special occasions.
47.zh: 我们只在特别场合使用这个应用。

52.en: A password manager can help curb unsafe habits.
52.zh: 密码管理器有助于改掉不安全的习惯。

54.en: The phone has the potential to replace my laptop for simple tasks.
54.zh: 这部手机有潜力在简单任务上取代我的笔记本电脑。
